description: This file defines the BuzzFeedPost class, a data transfer object (DTO) for representing posts in the OrangeHRM Buzz social feed module. It encapsulates properties related to a share/post such as employee info, post content, media links, statistics, and provides methods for accessing these details.

classes.name: BuzzFeedPost
classes.description: Data Transfer Object representing a Buzz post, supporting retrieval of post details, media, and permissions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the share/post.

methods.name: getPostId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the post.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the textual content of the post or share.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the post type: video, photo, or text.

methods.name: getStats
methods.description: Provides counts of likes, comments, and shares for the post.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date in Y-m-d format.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time in H:i format.

methods.name: getOriginalPost
methods.description: Returns details of the original post if this is a shared post.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Provides employee information related to the share.

methods.name: isLiked
methods.description: Indicates whether the post is liked by the current user.

methods.name: getVideoLink
methods.description: Retrieves the video URL if available.

methods.name: getPhotoIds
methods.description: Returns photo IDs associated with the post if photos are present.

methods.name: hasPhotos
methods.description: Checks if the post contains photos.

methods.name: hasVideo
methods.description: Checks if the post contains a video.

methods.name: getPermission
methods.description: Returns permission flags indicating if the post can be updated or deleted.
